subject: slovenian
summary: Slovenian is one of the better language decks. Questions are clear, the 2018 vocabulary card shows its five terms as a proper a) to e) list and labels each scheme answer with the term it explains, and the comprehension schemes are split into separate tickable points. The attached reading text is the right one each time and its first page holds only the passage. Faults: mixed and mismatched quotation marks around terms, a very long grey note stuffed into the first scheme box of the vocabulary card, an essay card with no criteria and a 0-40 grid, and a card worth 'no marks of its own' whose badge reads '1. DEL: 30m in all', which is confusing.

issues.title: Mismatched quotation marks around terms
issues.detail: The five terms use five different quote styles, several with an opening mark of one kind and a closing mark of another: »gneča«, ”razvoj«, “čebelarstvo”, ”družabno/družbeno omrežje«, ”kulturna dediščina”. Card 2 has ”Šotor”. and card 3 opens its quotation with a closing mark (”Če kdaj ...”). It reads as a text-encoding slip.
issues.suggested_fix: Normalise to one style (»...« for Slovenian) across question text and scheme labels.

issues.title: Long grey note in the first scheme box
issues.detail: The first tick box of the vocabulary card opens with 'For "gneča": The examination requires every answer in SLOVENIAN ... The scheme reprints the five expressions as ...' followed by all five reprinted instructions. That is 14 lines of small grey text on the phone before a three-line answer; the other four boxes have a clean one-line 'For ...' label.
issues.suggested_fix: Keep only 'For "gneča"' as the label, like the other four; state the language rule once outside the boxes and drop the list of reprinted instructions.

issues.title: Essay card with no criteria and a 0-40 grid
issues.detail: The essay scheme reads 'The scheme prints no answer for this part', then seven lines of grey explanation, then 41 number buttons, under the heading 'Select the points you actually got'. There is nothing for the student to mark against. The instruction 'choose one of the given titles' runs straight into the single title shown.
issues.suggested_fix: Drop the grid and the long explanation; show one plain line and the three self-grade buttons. Put the instruction on its own line.

issues.title: Unscored card with a confusing marks badge
issues.detail: Where the paper gives 30 marks for the whole part, the card header says 'The paper gives 30 marks for 1. DEL as a whole, not for each question', the badge says '1. DEL: 30m in all', a grey panel repeats the same sentence, and the footer says 'Nothing on this card can be scored'. The same message appears four times and a one-word vocabulary item carries a '30m' badge. The answer still has a tick box that does nothing.
issues.suggested_fix: Say it once ('Not marked separately - part of the 30 marks for Part 1'), remove the 30m badge and the tick box, and show the model answer as plain text.

issues.title: Orange underline stops mid-word-group
issues.detail: The underline covers the first line and a half of the question and stops at arbitrary points: 'navedite, ali se strinjate s' on card 1, 'Je gonilo družbenega' on card 5.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove the underline for non-English questions or restrict it to the command verb.

issues.title: Paragraph numbers after terms not explained; truncated point
issues.detail: The bracketed numbers after each term, '(3)', '(9)', are paragraph references but look like marks beside a 5-mark badge. One scheme point on card 5 ends in an ellipsis: 'izzive v razvoju npr. digitalnem ...'.
issues.suggested_fix: Write '(odstavek 3)' or 'para. 3'; check the truncated point against the scheme.

good_examples.why: Terms shown as an a) to e) list and each scheme answer labelled with its term
Six separate, readable scheme points for an opinion question
Three clear full-sentence points; correct passage attached
